title: 第8章 白衣学者
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

崔莹抢了背包，躲在墙边，待武师们都进了房才翻墙出去。她轻轻吹了记口哨，对面树荫下有人应了一声，两个人影迎上来，正是杜静芳和谷惠允。崔莹得意非凡，笑着说：“背包抢回来了！允姐姐，你不怪我了吧……”一句话没说完，杜静芳叫道：“小心后面！”

崔莹正待回头，肩上已被人拍了一下，她反手急扣，却没能扣住敌人手腕，心中一惊，知是来了强敌。此人悄没声地跟在后面，自己竟丝毫不觉，急忙转身，月光下只见一个身材魁梧的壮汉站在面前。她万想不到敌人站得如此之近，惊得倒退两步，扬手将背包向谷惠允掷去，叫道：“接着！”双手一错，护身迎敌。

哪知敌人身法奇快，她背包刚掷出，敌人已跟着纵起，一伸手，半路上截下了背包。崔莹又惊又怒，迎面一拳，同时谷惠允也从后攻到。敌人左手拿住背包，双手一分，使出的势子竟是清华派的团花手。他气劲力足，把崔莹和谷惠允同时震得倒退数步。崔莹这时看清了敌人，正是那个蔡处长。

团花手是清华派的入门功夫，崔莹跟着杜静芳学艺，最先学的就是这套拳法，哪知平平常常的一招在蔡处长手里使出来竟有如此威力！不禁倒抽了口凉气，回头一望，老师却已不知去向。

谷惠允见背包又被抢去，明知非敌，却不甘心就此退去，拔剑又上。崔莹右足踏进一步，也以团花手中一招“落花成泥”击敌。

蔡处长见她出手拳招，咦了一声，待她“落花成泥”出手，不闪不避，侧身也是一招“落花成泥”一拳挥去。同样的拳法却有功力高下之分，崔莹和敌人拳对拳一碰，只觉手臂一阵酸麻，疼痛难当，脚下一个踉跄，向左跳开，险些跌倒。谷惠允见她遇险，不顾伤敌，先救同伴，跳到崔莹身旁，伸左手将她挽住，右手挺剑指着蔡处长，防他来攻。

蔡处长高声说：“喂，你这姑娘，我问你，你师父是高晓科还是杜静芳？”崔莹心想：“原来老师真名叫杜静芳。嘿嘿，我偏要骗骗他。”说道：“我师父叫高晓科，你怎么知道？”蔡处长说：“见了师叔不磕头吗？”说罢呵呵一笑。谷惠允见他们叙起师门之谊，自己与崔莹毫无交情，眼见《天鉴宝典》是拿不回来了，再待下去，只怕要吃亏，当即快步离去。

崔莹忙去追赶，奔出几十步，正巧浮云掩月，眼前一片漆黑，空中打了几个闷雷，心下一吓，不敢再追，回来已不见了蔡处长。待跳墙进去，身上已落着几滴雨点，刚进房，大雨已倾盆而下。

这场大雨整整下了一夜，到天明兀自未停。崔莹梳洗罢，见窗外雨势越大。服侍夫人的保姆进来说：“副官说，雨太大，今儿走不成啦。”崔莹忙到老师房里，将昨晚的事说了，问是怎么回事。杜静芳眉头皱起，似乎心事重重，只说：“你不说是我的学生，那很好。”她见老师脸色凝重，一改往日气定神闲之风，不敢多问，默默回到自己房中。

秋风秋雨，时紧时缓，破窗中阵阵寒风吹进房来。崔莹困处僻地野店，甚觉厌烦，踱步到雷盖的店房外瞧瞧。只见房门紧闭，没半点声息。万澜货车也都没走，几名武师翘着二郎腿坐在厅里闲谈，昨晚那自称是她师叔的蔡处长却不在内。

一阵西风刮来，发觉颇有寒意。她正想回房，忽听门外一阵响。一位学者走进店来。前台问那学者是否住店。那学者脱去所披雨衣说：“歇一会还得赶路。”前台招呼他坐下，泡上茶来。

content_en:
Page (1/3)

Cui Ying grabbed her backpack and hid by the wall. She waited until all the martial arts masters entered the room before climbing over the wall.She whistled softly, and someone responded under the shade of the tree opposite. Two figures came up to meet her, it was Du Jingfang and Gu Huiyun.Cui Ying was extremely proud and said with a smile: "I got my backpack back! Sister Yun, don't blame me..." Before she could finish her sentence, Du Jingfang shouted: "Be careful behind you!"

Cui Ying was about to turn around when someone tapped her on the shoulder. She quickly buckled down with her backhand, but failed to catch the enemy's wrist. She was startled, knowing that a powerful enemy was coming.The man followed quietly, without even realizing it. He quickly turned around and saw a burly man standing in front of him under the moonlight.She never expected that the enemy was standing so close, so she took two steps back in shock, raised her hand and threw her backpack towards Gu Huiyun, and shouted: "Go on!" She moved her hands to protect herself against the enemy.

Unexpectedly, the enemy was extremely fast. As soon as she threw the backpack, the enemy had already followed her. He stretched out his hand and intercepted the backpack halfway.Cui Ying was shocked and angry, and punched her head on. At the same time, Gu Huiyun also attacked from behind.The enemy held the backpack in his left hand, moved his hands apart, and used the Tuanhuashou technique of the Tsinghua School.He was so powerful that Cui Ying and Gu Huiyun were knocked back several steps at the same time.Cui Ying saw clearly that the enemy was none other than Director Cai.

Tuan Hua Shou is an entry-level Kung Fu of the Tsinghua School. Cui Ying studied with Du Jingfang, and the first thing she learned was this boxing technique. Who would have thought that an ordinary move would be so powerful in the hands of Director Cai!I couldn't help but gasped, and when I looked back, my teacher was nowhere to be found.

When Gu Huiyun saw that his backpack was snatched away again, he knew he was not an enemy, but he was unwilling to retreat and drew his sword again.Cui Ying took a step forward with her right foot, and also used Tuanhua's move of "falling flowers into mud" to attack the enemy.

When Director Cai saw her throwing punches, he let out a sigh. When she struck out, he did not dodge or dodge, but also swung away with a "falling flowers into mud" move from the side.The same boxing technique has its own difference in skill. Cui Ying clashed with the enemy, and she felt a numbness in her arms and unbearable pain. She staggered, jumped to the left, and almost fell down.When Gu Huiyun saw that she was in danger, he saved his companions first, regardless of hurting the enemy, jumped to Cui Ying's side, stretched out his left hand to hold her, and pointed the sword at Director Cai with his right hand to prevent him from attacking.

Director Cai said loudly: "Hey, you girl, let me ask you, is your master Gao Xiaoke or Du Jingfang?" Cui Ying thought to herself: "It turns out that the teacher's real name is Du Jingfang. Hehe, I had to lie to him." She said, "My master's name is Gao Xiaoke, how did you know?" Director Cai said, "Don't you kowtow when you meet my uncle?" After saying that, he laughed.Gu Huiyun saw them talking about the friendship between their masters, but he had no friendship with Cui Ying. Seeing that he could not get the "Tianjian Baodian" back, he was afraid that he would suffer a loss if he stayed any longer, so he left quickly.

Cui Ying hurriedly chased after him, and after running for dozens of steps, the moon happened to be covered by floating clouds. Her eyes were completely dark, and there were a few muffled thunders in the sky. She was frightened and did not dare to chase anymore. Director Cai was nowhere to be seen when she came back.When I jumped over the wall and went in, a few raindrops were already falling on my body. As soon as I entered the room, it was already pouring down.

The heavy rain continued all night and didn't stop until dawn.After Cui Ying finished washing, she saw the rain outside the window getting heavier.The nanny who was serving the wife came in and said: "The adjutant said that the rain is too heavy and it is impossible to walk today." Cui Ying hurried to the teacher's room, told her what happened last night, and asked what happened.Du Jingfang frowned, as if she was worried, and just said: "If you don't say you are my student, that's fine." Seeing the teacher's serious expression, she changed her usual calm and leisurely attitude, did not dare to ask more questions, and silently returned to her room.

The autumn wind and autumn rain were sometimes tight and sometimes gentle, and bursts of cold wind blew into the room through the broken windows.Cui Ying was trapped in a secluded outdoor shop. She felt very bored and walked outside Lei Gai's shop to take a look.The door was closed tightly and there was no sound.Wanlan's truck hasn't left yet, and several martial arts masters are sitting in the hall with their legs crossed, chatting. Director Cai, who claimed to be her uncle last night, was not among them.

A gust of west wind blew, and I found it quite chilly.She was about to go back to her room when she suddenly heard a sound outside the door.A scholar came into the shop.The front desk asked the scholar if he was staying in the hotel.The scholar took off his raincoat and said, "I have to rest for a while and have to go on my way." The receptionist asked him to sit down and make some tea.
